name: Sennyuu Enzou
source:
Father of Makino. Due to unforeseen circumstances regarding his daughter's possession, he sought out the protagonist's services to help his daughter.

He is a very troubled man deep down and is weighed down even further due to the responsibilities of the Sennyuu Group.
